summary: ORIX Corporation filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, reporting the monthly status of its ongoing share repurchase program. The company repurchased 6,034,300 common shares for JPY 38,801,136,400 during July 1-31, 2026, via market purchases under a discretionary dealing contract. This is part of a board-approved program (May 11, 2026) authorizing up to 100 million shares (approx. 9.1% of total outstanding) and JPY 250 billion through March 31, 2027. Cumulative repurchases as of July 31, 2026 totaled 12,385,000 shares for JPY 78,448,326,300. The filing is a routine status update under Japan's Companies Act, equivalent to a US share repurchase disclosure. What to watch: continued execution pace relative to authorization, which could support share price but not a special event.
